name: Western Caucasus
description: The Western Caucasus covers about 275,000 hectares at the far western end of the Caucasus range, roughly 50 km north-east of the Black Sea in Russia. It is one of Europe's last large mountain areas left largely untouched by people. Wild animals alone have grazed its alpine meadows, and unbroken forest climbs from the lowlands to the high pastures. It is also where the mountain European bison was reintroduced.
